BMSvision is not just another tech company; they are your go-to partner for Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES) in the discrete manufacturing industry, with a specific focus on the textile, plastics and packaging industries. Their highly skilled R&D experts are passionate about developing top-notch hardware and software solutions that register productivity, quality and energy consumption data. This empowers their customers to fine-tune their operations for optimal efficiency.

Established in 2008 as a spin-off by Barco and currently part of the Vandewiele group, the BMSvision team has gained substantial experience learning from a large installed base in the plastics and textile industry. Their MES-solutions seamlessly integrate with ERP systems, addressing the requirements of Industry 4.0 and the broader Smart Factory landscape.

They’ve established their presence in Belgium (HQ), the UK, the US, China, India, Malaysia and Turkey. Additionally, they’ve built a worldwide network of agents and service centers.

Jobomschrijving

Drive international growth by helping manufacturers succeed in their Industry 4.0 journey

• You will be responsible for selling MES-systems to B2B customers in the global growth markets of textiles and plastics.
• You focus on medium and large enterprises and you'll speak to strategic decision makers (owners, general management, IT and production management).
• In the countries where you operate, you will work together with sales agents. You research the market potential of your countries, select quality partners with a good reputation, evaluate their activities and visit prospects whose doors they will open.
• You are responsible for preparing offers, launching marketing campaigns and making presentations.
• You participate in national and international fairs.
• You think along with the customer and convince them that BMS is their suitable partner for their Industry 4.0 strategy.

• You hold a technical or technical/economic master’s degree or you've built up equivalent expertise through experience and you have a strong affinity with software-driven solutions.
• Ideally, you bring around 10 years of experience in Sales or Business Development, preferably within the manufacturing industry, where you have successfully positioned business operations or MES-related software.
• You feel at ease collaborating with stakeholders at different levels and you have a proven track record in complex, project-driven sales environments with longer sales cycles.
• You love to travel internationally frequently and you are interested in other cultures.
• You communicate fluently in English and any additional language skills, such as French, German, Italian, etc., are a strong asset.
• Continuous learning energizes you. You enjoy negotiating, building long-term relationships and taking ownership.
• You combine an entrepreneurial mindset with strong self-management skills, all within a collaborative corporate culture where pragmatism, intrapreneurship and responsibility truly matter.

Are you passionate about cybersecurity, threat detection, and defending organizations against evolving cyber threats?

We are looking for a Cyber Security Analyst to join a leading international cybersecurity organization in Belgium. You’ll work alongside experienced security professionals, using modern technologies and security frameworks to detect, investigate, and respond to cyber incidents.
Role
As a Cyber Security Analyst, you will be responsible for monitoring security environments, investigating potential threats, and supporting customers during security incidents.

Key responsibilities include:

• Triage and investigate alerts generated by SIEM, EDR/endpoint protection, network detection, and other security tools
• Conduct threat hunting investigations and campaigns
• Escalate relevant threats to customers and provide actionable security advice
• Identify anomalies and attack patterns across the MITRE ATT&CK framework
• Support customers during security incidents and contribute to effective incident response
• Continuously improve detection rules, processes, and investigation methodologies
• Support onboarding projects for new customers
• Prepare and deliver monthly security reports on customer environments
ProfileWhat We're Looking For
• Full professional proficiency in English
• Conversational knowledge of Dutch and French
• Degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Digital Forensics, Engineering, or equivalent industry-recognized certification/relevant experience
• Initial hands-on experience in Cyber Security Operations, ideally within a Blue Team/SOC environment
• Understanding of:
• Threat hunting
• Incident detection & response
• Penetration testing concepts
• Malware analysis
• Strong analytical and investigative skills
• Customer-oriented mindset and ability to communicate technical topics to both technical and non-technical audiences
• Structured, process-oriented approach with strong attention to detail
• Ability to quickly learn and adapt to new technologies and security solutionsNice to Have
• Experience with SIEM, SOAR, EDR, sandboxing, honeypots, or endpoint protection
• Knowledge of AI and security automation
• Cybersecurity/SOC-related certifications

jobs.occupation: Experienced Wheel Loader Operator Wanted for Recycling Site in Sint-Katelijne-Waver
jobs.description:
For our client, a leading recycling company in Sint-Katelijne-Waver, I am looking for an experienced wheel loader operator. You play a crucial role in keeping the material flow around our fixed crushing installation running smoothly. You actively work with the team and support daily operations wherever needed.

On an average day, you operate the wheel loader to move, sort, and stockpile rubble and recycled aggregates. You supply the crushing installation and assist with loading and unloading trucks. Operating a forklift is also part of your tasks, as well as carrying out daily inspections and basic maintenance of the machines. You promptly report technical issues and ensure the workplace remains safe and tidy, even in dusty conditions.

Does this hands-on, varied position appeal to you? Apply soon – I am happy to tell you more about this great opportunity.

• Valid wheel loader license (required by Belgian regulations)

• At least 1 to 2 years of relevant experience as a wheel loader operator

• Willingness to operate a forklift (license is a plus)

• Good command of English (spoken and written)

• Able to work independently and reliably

• Hands-on mentality and flexible

• Punctual, communicative, and in good physical condition

• Willing to work in a dusty, outdoor industrial environment

jobs.occupation: Become a Truck Mechanic – Put Your Technical Skills to Work for the Future!
jobs.description:
As a truck mechanic, you’ll be responsible for performing accurate diagnostics and repairs on trucks, with a strong focus on DAF vehicles. You see electrical malfunctions as challenges, read wiring diagrams with ease, and work according to the latest technical guidelines. You communicate clearly with customers and manufacturers about your work and support our branch in Herent when needed.

Your day starts in a fully equipped workshop where you collaborate with a young, dynamic team. You begin by planning the necessary repairs, running diagnostics with advanced equipment, and ensuring every truck is safe and ready for the road. You coordinate colleagues and provide technical support, helping the whole team deliver top results.

Ready to take the next step in your career as a mechanic? Apply today and let our enthusiastic team guide you as you grow and thrive!

• You have a technical diploma (A3/A2) in automotive mechanics or equivalent experience

• A bachelor’s degree in automotive technology is a plus

• At least 2 years of relevant experience in the automotive sector

• You have basic knowledge of electronics and experience with wiring diagrams

• You can work independently and take responsibility

• Experience in leading a team is an advantage

• Good command of English is required

• A C(E) driver’s license is an asset but not required

Do you also love fries and are looking for a new challenge? Our client is a leading player in the production and development of potato-based delicacies. Due to further growth of the Wielsbeke site, we are looking for a Malfunction Technician curative maintenance in night shift As a technician, you are the key to quickly and efficiently solving technical malfunctions on our fully automated machinery. Your goal? Ensure smooth operation and minimise downtime.
 
 
 
• Be an example in adhering to prescribed guidelines and procedures for a safe, environmentally conscious, and orderly working environment. 
 
• Dive deep into mechanical, electrical, hydraulic, and pneumatic systems to diagnose and resolve faults. 
 
• Perform repairs and replace defective parts to keep our machines in top condition. 
 
• Work closely with our operations teams and your technical colleagues to minimise breakdowns and maximise efficiency. 
 
• Keep fault reports in our maintenance software (Ultimo) to gain insight and keep improving. 
 
• Share your expertise and advise on possible improvements to prevent repeat breakdowns. 
 
• You will mentor new employees to help them grow in their roles

• You have a technical education or equivalent experience
